title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: No-admission UMKC activities and nearby public art stops, with student-access requirements noted.

cards.title: Play billiards at the Student Union
cards.subtitle: Level 2, UMKC Student Union
cards.notes: Bring a UMKC ID to the Welcome Desk, check out the pool equipment, and return it when your game wraps up.
cards.short_summary: A campus pool-table session with equipment checkout included.
cards.evidence_claim: UMKC states that students can enjoy billiards free of charge during Student Union operating hours with ID-based equipment checkout.
cards.access_notes: UMKC student ID is required to check out equipment at the Welcome Desk; available during operating hours.

cards.title: Set up a table-tennis game
cards.subtitle: Level 2, UMKC Student Union
cards.notes: Meet beside Starbucks on Level 2, then use your UMKC ID at the Welcome Desk to borrow table-tennis accessories.
cards.short_summary: A bring-a-friend ping-pong stop in the Union.
cards.evidence_claim: UMKC lists table tennis next to Starbucks on Student Union Level 2 and says students may check out accessories with their UMKC ID.
cards.access_notes: Present a UMKC ID at the Welcome Desk and return borrowed accessories after use.

cards.title: Join an intramural team or tournament
cards.subtitle: Campus Recreation, Swinney Center
cards.notes: Check the RooSports options, gather a team or sign up solo where available, and use the activity for low-stakes competition.
cards.evidence_claim: Campus Recreation says all UMKC fee-paying students can participate in intramurals for free.
cards.access_notes: Free for UMKC fee-paying students; non-students need a Campus Recreation membership and sports pass.

cards.title: Take a group fitness class together
cards.subtitle: Swinney Center
cards.notes: Choose a Campus Recreation class that fits your schedule and arrive ready to participate with a classmate or roommate.
cards.short_summary: Student group fitness at no extra charge.
cards.evidence_claim: UMKC reports that students can participate in group fitness classes at no extra cost.
cards.source_title: Campus Resources for Student Success and Wellness
cards.access_notes: For UMKC students; Campus Recreation facilities are in the Swinney Center.

cards.title: Cheer at a Kansas City home game
cards.subtitle: UMKC athletics venues
cards.notes: Check the home schedule, bring your student ID, and make a group plan around a Kansas City Athletics game.
cards.short_summary: Student-ID entry to UMKC’s Division I home games.
cards.evidence_claim: UMKC states that students enjoy free admission to all Kansas City Athletics home games with their student ID.
cards.access_notes: Free for UMKC students with student ID; confirm the sport’s home schedule and venue before going.

cards.title: Ride the campus shuttle between stops
cards.subtitle: Volker and Hospital Hill campuses
cards.notes: Use the shuttle to link a study stop, campus errand, or lunch plan without arranging a separate ride between campuses.
cards.short_summary: Free student transportation connecting UMKC campuses.
cards.evidence_claim: UMKC says its shuttle provides free transportation for students around the Volker and Hospital Hill campuses.
cards.source_title: Campus Resources for Student Success and Wellness
cards.access_notes: For students; UMKC says the route includes residential halls and prominent campus locations.

cards.title: Go to a Roos After Dark takeover
cards.subtitle: UMKC Student Union
cards.notes: Watch the event calendar for a Union takeover, then go with friends for the scheduled activities and entertainment.
cards.short_summary: A late-evening Student Union program with activities.
cards.evidence_claim: UMKC describes Roos After Dark Union Takeovers as Student Union events with free food, entertainment, and interactive activities.
cards.access_notes: Event availability varies; consult UMKC’s events calendar for a scheduled takeover.

cards.title: Catch a Union Programming Board event
cards.subtitle: UMKC campus and Kansas City outings
cards.notes: Follow UPB through RooGroups, choose a listed program, and use it as an easy way to meet up around an activity.
cards.evidence_claim: UMKC RooGroups says the Union Programming Board hosts fun and free events on and off campus.
cards.access_notes: Open event details, timing, and participation requirements vary by program; check RooGroups before attending.

cards.title: Start with Jump Into UMKC
cards.subtitle: UMKC Volker Campus
cards.notes: Incoming undergraduates can register after orientation, then use the multi-day program to meet peers through scheduled group activities.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost onboarding program for new UMKC undergraduates.
cards.evidence_claim: UMKC’s 2026 Jump Into UMKC listing says there is no cost to attend for incoming new-to-UMKC undergraduates who completed orientation and enrolled in fall courses.
cards.access_notes: Limited to eligible incoming, new-to-UMKC undergraduates who completed orientation and enrolled in fall courses; registration is required.

cards.title: Browse the Nelson-Atkins collection
cards.subtitle: 4525 Oak St., Kansas City
cards.notes: Meet in the galleries or pair the collection with a walk on the museum grounds; skip ticketed special exhibitions unless you choose to pay.
cards.short_summary: A nearby art-museum visit with free general admission.
cards.evidence_claim: The Nelson-Atkins says member support keeps general admission to the museum free for everyone.
cards.source_title: Teens, Volunteers, Membership - Nelson-Atkins Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: General admission is free; some special exhibitions, programs, and parking may have separate charges.
